nodes.header: theorem prob_reject {w q : ℕ} (hq : q ≤ w) : (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin w → Bool)).toOuterMeasure {f | Esa22Copy.Interface.acceptsAt q (Block.ofFun f) = false} = levelMiss q := by
